_comment: Machine-readable form of legal rule 6 of the project brief. Edit only on the owner's instruction.
allow: licences that may be used without asking.
ask_first_prefixes: licence families that always need the owner's decision.
Any identifier that is in neither list also yields needs-review (it was not pre-approved).
obligations: working summaries for the ledger's obligations column. They are NOT legal advice
and must be confirmed against the licence text by a qualified reviewer before release.

obligations.MPL-2.0: keep notices; when distributing in executable form, make the Source Code Form of the MPL-covered software (including our modifications) available and tell recipients how to get it; ship licence text (wording to be confirmed by legal review)
obligations.LGPL-2.0-only: ship licence text; provide library source incl. modifications; let users replace/relink the library; keep notices
obligations.LGPL-2.0-or-later: ship licence text; provide library source incl. modifications; let users replace/relink the library; keep notices
obligations.LGPL-2.1-only: ship licence text; provide library source incl. modifications; let users replace/relink the library; keep notices
obligations.LGPL-2.1-or-later: ship licence text; provide library source incl. modifications; let users replace/relink the library; keep notices
obligations.LGPL-3.0-only: ship LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts; provide library source incl. modifications; let users replace/relink the library; keep notices
obligations.LGPL-3.0-or-later: ship LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts; provide library source incl. modifications; let users replace/relink the library; keep notices
obligations.Apache-2.0: ship licence text; keep notices; mark modified files; reproduce NOTICE file content if one exists
obligations.X11: keep copyright and permission notice; do not use holder's name in advertising
obligations.BSD-2-Clause: keep copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer in source and in documentation of binaries
obligations.BSD-3-Clause: keep copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer in source and in documentation of binaries; no endorsement with holder names
obligations.BSD-4-Clause: as BSD-3-Clause plus acknowledgement in advertising materials (ask first)
obligations.Zlib: do not misrepresent origin; mark altered source versions; keep the notice in source
obligations.OFL-1.1: ship copyright and licence with the font; do not sell the font by itself; no Reserved Font Name on modified versions; no endorsement
obligations.BSL-1.0: keep licence text with source; not required for binaries
obligations.GPL-2.0-only: complete corresponding source of the combined work under GPL (ask first)
obligations.GPL-2.0-or-later: complete corresponding source of the combined work under GPL (ask first)
obligations.GPL-3.0-only: complete corresponding source of the combined work under GPL (ask first)
obligations.GPL-3.0-or-later: complete corresponding source of the combined work under GPL (ask first)
